run_SetEnvVar: set or unset an environment variable by name and value using SetEnvVar
run_UsesColor: run gtest_color_test_ subprocess with TERM and GTEST_COLOR env vars to check color output
test_GTestColorTest_testNoEnvVarNoFlag: test that color output is auto-detected based on TERM when no env var or flag is set
test_GTestColorTest_testFlagOnly: test color behavior when only the --gtest_color flag is provided without GTEST_COLOR env var
test_GTestColorTest_testAliasesOfYesAndN: test that --gtest_color accepts aliases like true, YES, T, 1, false, 0, and unknown
